info.title: GeoNerva domain API
info.description: Read-only hazard intelligence. Every response is parameterized by a knowledge time, every claim carries the evidence it came from, and an absence is always reported as an absence rather than as a zero. See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §13.

get.summary: Full location briefing: snapshot, changes, deterministic copy and evidence manifest.

200.description: The response contract, as frozen in `packages/domain`.

schema.const: varies: live s-maxage=120, swr=600; as_of older than 1 h s-maxage=86400, immutable

400.description: The request did not satisfy ARCHITECTURE §13.2.

404.description: The subject of the request does not exist at this knowledge time.

405.description: The API is read-only: only GET and HEAD are supported.

429.description: The caller has spent its window (ARCHITECTURE §13.4).

500.description: An unexpected failure. The body names nothing but a trace id.
